name: visual-docs-actions
//: The composite actions (action.yml, visual-docs/, visual-docs-aggregate/, visual-docs-pages/, gh-pages-maintenance/), the reusable workflow and its GitHub-hosted smoke tests, the scripts they run (scripts/visual-docs-*.sh), and the consumer documentation that restates their interface (README.md, examples/). None of those files moves: consumers reference them by path at @v0, so they are attached here through the `actions` inputs, and this directory holds only the project definition. `test` runs the crate's `actions` test binary, the contract suite over exactly these files. Depends on the crate (the actions build and run its binary, and that suite drives it); the demo's capture script and sync workflow, whose capture copies the suite checks, are inputs.
